post.description: Ends every session of the member's sign-in, on every device (platform.user.manage, step-up), with a coded reason, audited before the sessions end. A location role reaches only members whose roles and grants in force are all at its locations; anyone else reads as not found (audited by opaque id). When the member's devices last reported entries waiting, the sign-out needs confirmEntriesWaiting (409 entries_waiting otherwise): signing out removes the care record from their phone until they sign in again, and the entries not yet sent stay on it until then. For staff_left or suspended, the holds on those devices fall due at once, as after a device revocation.

post.summary: Record an enquiry: a new person record at enquiry (people.md rule 1)
post.description: people.enquiry.manage at the location the enquiry is about. Names and a date of birth (1900 to today) only; the assessment starts with POST /v1/people/{id}/status (to pre_admission). The time it came in may be earlier than now, never later, before 1900 or before the birth. The answer is the record's id and state, never the person's details. A request sent again by the same person with the same id and details answers as the first (replayed); the same id with other details is refused with 409 `id_reused_with_different_details`; an id in use for anything else is refused (422). Refusals are audited with opaque ids.

post.summary: Change a person's status (people.md rules 1 and 2)
post.description: Checked with checkPersonStatusChange: the permission, reason and step-up of the PERSON_LIFECYCLE move, a time neither in the future (beyond the clock-drift tolerance) nor before the current status began, a discharge that says whether it is a transfer, archiving only once the exit workflow has closed, and no re-admission after a death. Admission has its own route. The effects run in the same transaction: rounds paused or resumed, future tasks cancelled, sharing closed, the bed released or the room held, the exit workflow started or cancelled, and one outbox event. A death recorded in error is corrected with a reason and step-up (HZ-001).
